description: Deep blue tubular flowers on a vigorous perennial. The single best hummingbird plant you can grow in Buenos Aires.
ecology: Spreads into dense clumps and blooms for months, giving the herbaceous layer a long nectar season.
wildlifeNotes: Multiple observers confirm that salvia guaranítica planted in quantity produces abundant hummingbird visits right through the warm season. Plant it in a block rather than as single plants.
flowering: Warm season, often for many months
propagation: Easy from cuttings, and spreads on its own into dense clumps.
medicinalUses: The Guaraní used it as an anti-inflammatory and for skin conditions.
sources: Picaflores de la plaza, Aves Bonaerenses: http://avesbonaerenses.blogspot.com/2014/03/picaflores-de-la-plaza.html
